facts.fact: 蛇蜕课回放：七岁 Nikolas 捡蛇蜕问母——「It no longer fits them...When you outgrow them, or if they become too tattered to wear, you have no need of them anymore. You find something new.」
蜕变现场：跪地多翼丛生（rib/upper arms/thighs 皆裂）——「Soon enough there would be no more skin to shed. Soon enough he’d be in two pieces: his destroyed flesh, and his exoskeleton.」——翼自空眼窝开出白金羽扇。
facts.anchor: Soon enough he’d be in two pieces:

facts.fact: 神召：「Come and kneel before me.」——「I am not yours,」he snarled——Fin「Keep resisting, Sunshine」；Julian 留言「Keep him safe」奔西；Edwin+Rian 赴南塔。
火线委托：Julian 穿心掏脏救 Taesia——「Julian…」「Kill the ones I don't.」——「He was a demon that was free...yet the command incited him all the same.」——「beating for her」。

Faün 心战：Taesia 拆梦——「I've seen your dreams, Faün ost Vonlin...You wanted to become greater than Varrick...You thought you could become godlike when Phos only ever meant for you to be his lapdog.」——volucris 兽群应召而来。
facts.anchor: You thought you could become godlike

facts.fact: 二番合咒：Dante 拉人入影——「What we did in Nexus. In the palace square. We have to do it again.」——Orsus 打断：Enough——右手失主、被令画六芒大阵。
facts.anchor: We have to do it again.

facts.fact: 神之手：Orsus 夺身画阵——snap——「He could parse the individual strands of quintessence...Even the sun rising to the north was a condensed ball of aether.」「How else do you think the realms were formed?」
facts.anchor: How else do you think the realms were formed?

facts.fact: 活埋收章：volucris unraveled（spun out like tattered yarn）——地面融化吞军团（Faün 呼 Lord Daystar 无应）——「Buried alive, encased within stone.」——「he finally, miserably accepted...That he was the fifth heir, and as much a pawn to his god as they were to theirs.」
facts.anchor: as much a pawn to his god as they were to theirs.
